caption:
Lemon Coriander Rice
comfort food | leftover recipe | 10 minute meal 

Ingredients
2 tbsp sesame oil 
1 onion, finely chopped
1 green chilli finely chopped 
large handful coriander, finely chopped 
6-7 cloves of garlic, minced
1 inch ginger, ginely chopped
1/2 tbsp soy sauce 
1 tbsp green sauce OR 1 tbsp red chinsu 
1 lemon’s juice
2-3 cups cooked leftover rice that has been in the fridge for atleast 12 hours

Method 
heat the oil and then add to the ingredients as shown in the video, sizzle it up then toss in the rice, then the sauces mix it together and serve 

I either serve with my gochujang eggs or korean braised tofu!! both recipes coming soon!!
or wanna go simple, just add a soft boiled egg or fried egg on top :)
